turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on am, is and are?
turns.tutor:
Here is my example. "It ___ old." Who? It. It goes with is. So: It is old.
The rule is: am after I, is after he, she, it, and are after you, we, they.
Right: He is at work. Wrong: He at work.
Now your turn. Please write the missing word only:
Write am, is or are: I ___ a student. (answer with only the missing word)
